name: vest
title: New vest
summary: A new vest built on a vanilla one: its own class and textures on the vanilla model, the vanilla attachment slots and cargo, and a loot entry.

parent.help: Vanilla vest the new one inherits

attachment.help: Vanilla item for the attach check; it must fit a slot of the parent

cargo.help: Vanilla item for the cargo check; it must fit the parent's cargo

classes.name: {item}
classes.notes: scope 2. Keeps the parent's inventorySlot, attachments[], cargo and ClothingTypes models.

files.what: Add {parent_addon} to requiredAddons[] and the {item} class to CfgVehicles.

tasks.task: Add class {item} : {parent} to CfgVehicles with scope 2, displayName and descriptionShort. Set hiddenSelectionsTextures for {parent_selections}, one entry per selection. Add {parent_addon} to requiredAddons[].
Make {item_lower}_co.paa from the user's PNG or TGA source with /dayz-pack-texture, laid out like the {parent} texture.
tasks.done: The .paa exists at the path T1 put in hiddenSelectionsTextures.

tasks.task: Add a types.xml entry for {item} with /dayz-edit-types, starting from the vanilla {parent} entry.
tasks.done: The entry exists and min is not above nominal.
